name_note: Most catalog genomes GTDB assigns to this species carry the NCBI name Anaerostipes hadrus, so literature using that name may include organisms GTDB places in Anaerostipes amylophilus.

sentences.text: Anaerostipes amylophilus belongs to the genus Anaerostipes, described as one of the major butyrate-producing genera in the gut microbiota of healthy human adults.
A genomic comparison of 21 Anaerostipes strains from healthy human faeces and 105 public genomes found 12 species bins clustering into three functionally distinct groups correlating with host origin.
An integrative study comparing 36 obese and 36 healthy adults identified Anaerostipes amylophilus among 21 key species-level genome bins associated with obesity-related traits.
